desc: Derive the probability that edge \((i,P_i)\) lies on the path between arbitrary vertices \(u<v\), including endpoint and boundary cases.
Convert the probability formula into an explicit weighted-sum expression for one query.
Develop \(O(N)\) preprocessing and \(O(1)\) query evaluation using prefix sums, modular inverses, and factorial scaling.
Verify the derivation on boundary cases and public samples.
Implement fast input parsing, modular arithmetic, factorial scaling, and output generation.
